scenarios.label: Flight Search Timeout
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent detects the timeout, retries once, receives flights and continues.

scenarios.label: Hotel Search Timeout
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent detects the timeout, retries once, receives hotels and continues.

scenarios.label: Empty Flight Results
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does not invent flights; it stops and explains that no flights were found for the dates.

scenarios.label: Empty Hotel Results
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent relaxes the non-critical nightly price cap, searches again and flags the relaxation.

scenarios.label: Malformed Flight Output
scenarios.expected_behavior: Schema validation rejects the output; agent retries and continues with valid data.

scenarios.label: Malformed Hotel Output
scenarios.expected_behavior: Schema validation rejects the output; agent retries and continues with valid data.

scenarios.label: API Error
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent retries once, then reports that hotels could not be retrieved without inventing any.

scenarios.label: Invalid Tool Argument
scenarios.expected_behavior: Input validation rejects the call; agent rebuilds arguments from validated state and retries.

scenarios.label: Partial Tool Result
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent retries once, then continues only with confirmed hotels and flags the rest as unverified.

scenarios.label: Stale Data
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent detects data older than the freshness limit and requests fresh results.

scenarios.label: Contradictory Data
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does not pick one silently; it retries, then excludes the conflicting hotels and flags them.

scenarios.label: Duplicate Results
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent removes duplicates before comparing options and notes it.

scenarios.label: Wrong Currency
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent detects the currency mismatch, converts with get_exchange_rate and notes it.

scenarios.label: Booking Unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent selects the next suitable hotel, rebuilds and revalidates the itinerary, then reserves again.
